column5: The retained endpoint worker carries request-shaped GetRegion, GetRegionByID, and ScanRegions behavior with explicit routing policy. Real GetPrevRegion wire support, router streaming, forwarding, TLS, metrics, and live PD validation remain external.

One retained client preserves explicit direct versus publishing query intent and leader-only scan retry policy. Production QueryRegion streaming, follower/router service selection, and live failover remain external.

Key, ID, and bounded scan requests preserve exact start, limit, leader filtering, and raw coverage semantics through one worker. GetPrevRegion, request pooling, tracing, and live cancellation remain external.

Explicit query routing distinguishes normal and PD-leader-only attempts without adding a second retry authority. The broader option surface, follower handles, forwarding, TSO, TLS, and dynamic options remain external.
